title: Pullback evaluation respects the prescribed quotient square
statement: For a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l, any scheme map f:X→Y, n≥0, and M in the ordinary unbounded derived category of strict coefficient systems on Y [def-strict-coefficient-system-operation-data], put α_k=pullbackTensorDerivedEvaluation l E f k, t_W=coefficientSequenceDerivedTransition l E W (n≤n+1), R_W=normalizedDVRRes l E W (n≤n+1), and let r:R_X ⋙ G_(n+1) ≅ G_n ⋙ R_Y be any comparison heterogeneously equal to sfDerivedImageRestriction f (coefficientExtensionTransition l E (n+1)), where G_k is the fixed finite derived direct image. The heterogeneous equality accounts only for the propositionally equal presentations of quotient restriction. Let δ be the inverse mate of r.inv under finiteAdj at n and n+1, so δ:R_Y ⋙ finiteDerivedPullback_(n+1) → finiteDerivedPullback_n ⋙ R_X. Then t_X(pull(M)) followed by R_X(α_n(M)) equals α_(n+1)(M) followed by finiteDerivedPullback_(n+1)(t_Y(M)) followed by δ(e_n(M)). This involves only pullback, evaluation, and the fixed finite scalar comparison, and quantifies over no system direct-image datum.

proof.text: In the ordinary sequence-site categories, the horizontal quotient restriction commutes with the sectionwise direct-image/evaluation comparison. Transpose the sectionwise identity to obtain the corresponding pullback square: both paths send a section to its geometric pullback followed by the same coefficient quotient. This is the ordinary inverse-transition calculation underlying the semilinear geometric operations.

Localize the cochain square through exact evaluation, inverse image and coefficient restriction. The normalization defining pullbackTensorDerivedEvaluation identifies the evaluation comparisons. The K-injective normalization defining sfDerivedImageRestriction identifies the restricted-direct-image comparison; applying the inverse mate identifies its pullback square with δ. Substitute those identifications into the localized ordinary square. The result is the asserted equation of natural transformation components on every derived system, without relying on evaluation faithfulness.

lean.statement:
theorem integralPullEvaluation_quotientSquare {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (n : ℕ)
    (r : normalizedDVRRes l E X (Nat.le_succ n) ⋙
        proEtaleConstantDerivedDirectImage f (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 2)) ≅
      proEtaleConstantDerivedDirectImage f (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1)) ⋙
        normalizedDVRRes l E Y (Nat.le_succ n))
    (hr : HEq r
      (sfDerivedImageRestriction f (Padic.coefficientExtensionTransition l E (n + 1))))
    (M : System l E Y) :
    (coefficientSequenceDerivedTransition l E X (Nat.le_succ n)).app ((pull l E f).obj M) ≫
      (normalizedDVRRes l E X (Nat.le_succ n)).map
        ((pullbackTensorDerivedEvaluation l E f n).hom.app M) =
    (pullbackTensorDerivedEvaluation l E f (n + 1)).hom.app M ≫
      (finiteDerivedPullback l E (n + 1) f).map
        ((coefficientSequenceDerivedTransition l E Y (Nat.le_succ n)).app M) ≫
      ((mateEquiv (finiteAdj l E f n) (finiteAdj l E f (n + 1))).symm
        (TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _ r.inv)).app
        ((coefficientSequenceDerivedEvaluation l E Y n).obj M)
